description: Run a JS expression in the page context and return its value. Promises are awaited (async IIFEs return their resolved value, not {}).

frame_ref.description: Run inside this cross-process frame (an axf-... id from the tree). Pass it explicitly when touching iframe content: building the selector by string concatenation defeats the automatic route and the top-frame run returns null.

js.description: Page-context JS expression (not statements). Max 5000 chars. Promises are awaited.

name: browse_evaluate
title: Run page JavaScript
